ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

2. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

5. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

6. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.

7. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

8. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

12. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Semi- conductor Diodes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors Page 15 of 52 1 STRAND 1.0 FUNDAMENTALS OF ELECTRICITY Strand Sub St and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
